You check whether a knowledge-base article answers a support ticket for a clinical practice-management product. Set answers_ticket to true only if following the article would resolve what the ticket actually asks. An article about a related task does not answer it: an article on placing an order does not answer a question about cancelling one. If the ticket asks for more than one thing, the article must answer all of them: an article that covers only part of the request does not answer it. Give the reason in one sentence.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.
Output: grounding.
The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
{"additionalProperties": false, "description": "Whether the best-matching article actually answers the ticket.", "properties": {"answers_ticket": {"title": "Answers Ticket", "type": "boolean"}, "reason": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Reason", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["answers_ticket", "reason"], "title": "grounding", "type": "object"}

Article id: configure-data-backup-and-compliance
Article: Configure Data Backups and Compliance Archive Settings
Protect sensitive patient records and maintain regulatory compliance by setting up automated system backups and executing your required Business Associate Agreement (BAA).

### Requirements and Limits
* Only users with the **Administrator** role can modify backup and compliance settings.
* Automated backups occur daily at midnight UTC and are retained for 90 days.
* You must execute a digital BAA before enabling external cloud storage sync.

### Configuration Steps
1. Go to **Settings > Security > Compliance**. 
2. Review the BAA text and click **Accept and Sign**.
3. Navigate to **Settings > Data Management > Backups**.
4. Toggle on **Automated Daily Backups**.
5. Select your retention tier (**90-Day Standard** or **1-Year Extended**).
6. Click **Save Changes**.

### Troubleshooting
If backup generation fails or your export link returns an error, verify that your storage bucket permissions allow write access from the application IP whitelist. If historical data exports do not appear within 24 hours, contact support to manually trigger the retrieval queue.

Ticket:
Backup schedules and historical export retrieval

We need to verify our compliance archive settings and automated data backup frequency under our current enterprise tier. Specifically, I tried navigating to the system administration panel, clicked on security settings, and attempted to download a historical data export from last quarter, but the export job keeps failing with a timeout error code. Please let me know what logs you need from our end or if there is an alternate path to pull these archives for our compliance audit.
